0: City of Santa Claus, Georgia Amendment to Existing Ordinance To be amended: Article V, Section 55 – 1983 Code of Ordinances Purpose: To protect and conserve value of property and property owners located in R-1 and R-2 zones.
2: “The principal building shall be of brick or brick veneer construction.” The lawful use of any building or structure existing at the time of enactment of this amendment may be continued even though such use does not conform to the provisions of this ordinance as amended, except that the non-conforming building or structure shall not be: (a) changed to another non-conforming use; (b) moved, modified, or structurally altered except in conformity with this ordinance, as amended.
